The war in Ukraine is already lost, he says, but NATO cannot survive admitting that loss. He still thinks Odessa is the likely terminal battle, after which Europe faces political collapse and eventual realignment. And he still thinks China is not a hegemonic civilizational project in the Western style, but a trading power that would prefer friendship with everyone to civilizational crusade.
